findings.description: afdc173f checks the wildcard arm first and stores the response under base|*, but the base is still the full raw target: /api?x, /api/?x and /?x all miss and refetch, /?x hits the local static handler. This is the depth contrast for the build whose store arm is always the wildcard: the wildcard saves the attacker only one AE dimension, not path breadth.
findings.title: afdc173f confirms the same key width: exact raw target, wildcard only on the encoding arm

limitations: All RCE in this corpus is RCE on the upstream host
